Backticks code block style uses triple backtick fences

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<pre><code class=\"language-js\">console.log('hi');</code></pre>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(code_block_style: 'Backticks'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
